title: Order-Aware Temporal Dynamics in Disorders of Consciousness: Multi-Scale Electrophysiological Modeling and Multicenter Evaluation
description: Official replication archive and artifact accompanying the manuscript 'Order-Aware Temporal Dynamics in Disorders of Consciousness: Multi-Scale Electrophysiological Modeling and Multicenter Evaluation'. Contains the complete Python source code for order-aware dynamical operators (rho_1, D_1, r_residual), decision fusion models (Linear C, Temporal MDCO, T-GECF), 10,000 synchronous counterfactual permutation tests, multicenter cross-cohort validation pipelines across 4 cohorts (Mendeley N=41, CRRC N=15, Figshare N=50, Wielek N=23; total N=129), unit tests, pre-extracted benchmark profiles, precomputed empirical tables, and the compiled 9-page IEEE JBHI manuscript and 2-page supplementary material.
